title: "What are you good at?" (Resume Tips)
description:
Recently we spoke to Customer Success Manager Ashleigh Bergh Duggan who shared a great way she learned how she figured out how to phrase her resume achievements. A resume is a difficult document to get right so like she said, go to someone who is in the role you're going for and ask them how you should frame your work wins. #resume #resumetips #resumeadvice

transcript: I have always struggled with writing my resume always struggled with articulating what I've done and the impact it's had and maybe that's because the roles that I've been and haven't always lended themselves to that kind of I did X and it resulted in y kind of thinking that we normally suggest people put on a resume the thing that I have found that's been very helpful actually go to people in similar roles and say to them how do I articulate this right and I asked somebody who's done it before me that's really where I started to be able to pull together the information I need could put on my resume in a way that made sense
